item.title: Yokoshima!! Pandemic
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kur-Mar-Ter
  • 発売日: 2010-08-27
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (27 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 邪!! ぱんでみっく
  • 英語名: Yokoshima!! Pandemic

别名

  • しまぱん学校霊と擬人化H

あらすじ

Rei attends Nagi Gakuen which is well-known for strange happenings. Since he was small, he has been able to sense spirits. One day, he met a mysterious girl at the abandoned old school building and many strange things kept happening afterwards. Deemed as the main culprit, he is invited to the 4K club (kagaku de wa kaimei dekinai kaii genshou o kenkyuu suru kurabu – club to investigate strange phenomena which cannot be explained by science) by club leader Otoha, but he doesn’t want anything to do with it.

item.title: Chuu Shite...
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kur-Mar-Ter

  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: チューして…
  • 英語名: Chuu Shite…

あらすじ

  • Kiss?

  • Yup. It means draw one month close to another month.

  • Why people kiss?

  • I do not know, but … I tried it yesterday

  • Does it tickle?

  • Yup. My mouth was licked as if it was going to be eaten

  • Fuwa …

  • So, let’s try it.

  • Yup…

And that girl pulled her lips towards me and closed her eyes.
